detail: the fence always names the language; bare ``` blocks are untestable and unhighlighted
the first command in a block works alone; prerequisites come as separate lines above it
every command in the first two blocks is run (or traced to the manifest) before being written; invented flags are bugs
show expected stdout/stderr when success is not visually obvious from the command itself
shell lines that depend on state the reader may lack carry a comment saying what that state is
example:
# requires docker daemon running
docker compose up -d

detail: when behavior differs across versions name the version the README documents rather than staying silent
named placeholders (YOUR_API_KEY) are uppercase + underscore + explained at first use; lorem-ipsum-style filler is never shipped
